text:
Morgan: heads up, small canary hit. routing policy switched mid-stream -> downgraded model, stream truncated, client retried and we saw a toolcall reissue. billing shows provisional + confirmed token spike for tenant.
Devin: link to trace? logs?
Morgan: trace: /console/trace/6110001234. snippet:
```
[router] ts=6110001234 req=orig-req-xyz route=policy-v9 -> model-base (downgrade) status=handoff
[proxy] ts=6110001235 req=orig-req-xyz retry=1 toolcall=tts.speak truncated=true
```
Devin: downgrade after prefix consumed -> retry created new toolcall without dedupe key. both stream tokens and toolcall tokens billed.
Arjun: proposal: include immutable origin_request_id + route_policy_version on all handoffs/retries so ledger can dedupe provisional credits when finalizing. small internal header change + ledger lookup.
Rachel: on console side we show provisional vs confirmed but can't correlate with routing. can we add a column for route_policy_version and badge for canary traffic? would help support with tenant billing questions.
Leo: implement headers `x-rw-origin-id` and `x-rw-route-v`. ledger dedupe rule: treat credits with same origin id + route-v within 2m as same logical request for provisional aggregation.
Morgan: also need to handle truncated streams where prefix capture id is lost and toolcall fires with no prefix context.
Devin: can we short-circuit toolcall creation if we detect it's a retry of a truncated stream? proxy shows `truncated=true` flag.
Arjun: yes: if origin id matches and previous session indicates truncated handoff, RPC should return a 409-like `conflict: already-accounted` that client treats as "reuse previous result" and not emit new toolcall. ledger marks provisional->confirmed when final ack arrives.
Rachel: UI followups: expose `route_v` in token-usage panel, add explainer: "route version mismatches can cause provisional duplicate credits during rollouts". add filter by `origin_id` for support lookup.
BillingBot: alert: provisional credits spike +3.2k tokens for tenant acme at 6110001236. auto-tag route_v=9 replicated=true
Leo: example internal curl:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "x-rw-origin-id: orig-req-xyz" \
  -H "x-rw-route-v: 9" \
  POST https://internal.redwood/proxy/infer -d '{"input":"..."}'
```
Arjun: schema changes: add `origin_id` (string), `route_v` (int) and indexed `dedupe_key`. retention default 7d.
Devin: perf worry: extra ledger lookup on hot path?
Arjun: single indexed lookup by dedupe_key should be <1ms p99. can be best-effort async if required.
Morgan: security: headers must be internal-only and authenticated. prevent client spoofing at edge.
Rachel: timeline: if eng-platform + billing ok, I can add route_v column + filter in console; low-risk.
Devin: I'll add unit + e2e tests in proxy: ensure `x-rw-origin-id` survives reconnect and duplicate toolcalls are rejected when dedupe exists. simulate truncated-stream + retry.
Leo: canary plan: feature-flag header + ledger dedupe. roll to 10% traffic for 48h and monitor token-usage by route_v.
Morgan: action items: Arjun: schema + ledger dedupe proto; Devin: proxy + tests; Rachel: console column + filter; Leo: feature flag + rollout; Morgan: postmortem + runbook update.
Rachel: quick Q: do we want provisional smoothing (1m avg) in UI to mute noisy spikes?
BillingBot: suggestion: provisional smoothing optional, off by default.
Devin: agree, toggleable.
Morgan: syncing 1pm. @Arjun can you draft the ledger migration note?
Arjun: yup, will ping for review before sync.
Leo: :thumbsup:
Rachel: :pray:
Morgan: thanks, closing thread for now."
